chemberta_mtr.note: featurization + prediction with 5 replicate models, measured on the screen itself over the 100M test set. Weighted by shard size. Timings come only from boxes that finished their whole range, since a manifest is written at the end of a range -- spot-reclaimed boxes left their predictions but not their timings, so shard coverage here is below 246 for most arms.
